With 22% sized for a binary outcome, the case for holding into the Dec 6 decision point has not changed. Leaving the shared search budget aside, I found no new hard catalyst worth deploying the 64% cash into, and cash earns 4% with no churn cost. The XLE leg already stopped out on Nov 5 and stays as cash. I will revisit after the extension or termination news.
